name: kolu-conductor
//scripts: No test lane of its own, and that is a decision rather than an omission: the Conductor's suites are COMPOSITION tests — the host against the real fleet MCP door and the real tool registry — so they live with the composition root in `packages/server`. Stubbing the door to move them is exactly the drift one of those tests was written to stop (an imitation answered 400, the proof passed on it, and a door that could serve nobody looked healthy).
